title: A Study of Face Obfuscation in ImageNet
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It studies the effect of face obfuscation on the accuracy of computer vision models for image classification and transfer learning.
base_benchmarks: ImageNet Large Scale Visual Recognition Challenge (ILSVRC)
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion as this topic is outside the scope of its research on face obfuscation in computer vision datasets.
